description: Dynamic attributes of an expanded JSON body's remaining body include taken properties
notes: The spec's partial processing leaves what the schema requested out of the remaining body. With dynamic blocks expanded, hashicorp/hcl answers dynamic attributes processing of the remaining body with every property of the original body (expandBody.JustAttributes in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go doesn't leave out what PartialContent took), so a is in the remaining body too.
